summary:
Two-week window. The client re-engaged, but the work she had already delivered went missing on ALTR's side. The first week (to 10-02) was almost silent: 10 messages, only 2 from Liza, both short billing replies. The second week flipped: 35 client messages and her first real questions in a month. The trigger was a new customs request. Aroosha introduced herself on 10-05 as the new customs owner ('I'll be assisting in all new customs moving forward'). On 10-08 Liza asked 'How much he paid for this?' and 'Also, did you got my videos for first three requested?'. ALTR could not find them. Aroosha: 'I don’t see that the first 3 were sent on my end (I just started a week ago though so I could be wrong).' Liza: 'I sent them like three weeks ago'. Those are the 09-24 Dropbox customs that went unacknowledged for two windows. They were lost in the Ronnie-to-Aroosha handoff, and the client had to point ALTR back to her own link ('It’s all here'). Aroosha handled it well (same-day reply, apology, real spender figure of $8.6k), but the delivery is still unconfirmed. Her other 09-24 question, 'What exactly you need , reels/ picks?', is 15 days unanswered. Mica's 10-06 'little social tip' was posted in that same topic without answering it. Liza did reply warmly to the tip, her first reply to Mica's coaching in months.

Billing: the Sep 15-30 invoice went out 10-01. Liza wired $6,000 the next day ('Send 6k more', tracking given). Stephski confirmed it 10-07 with a number: 'the 6k was received and just $2,224.88 is remaining'. The 09-24 wire that went missing turned out to have BOUNCED. Liza found that out herself ('420$ bounced back'), 14 days after sending it. Before she did, Stephski offered to credit money ALTR never received ('I know you did send the $400 so i can take that off of whats remaining even though we didnt recieve'). That is the second reconciliation error on this account caught by the client, after the $5,000 in August. Liza says the $2,224.88 remainder is already re-sent from Leticia Linss, but no receipt is confirmed at window close.

SECURITY: on 10-08 two unannounced IG farm vendor accounts (Stardust Nexus, Theta SDX) asked for 2FA on @Lizakovaal in the group chat ('I need 2FA for this IG @Lizakovaal'). Liza posted a live 6-digit 2FA code in plaintext and the vendor logged in ('I'm in.'). Nobody introduced the vendor. It is the same handle she reported deleted on 08-30, and the same one whose password Michelle re-posted on 09-12. Those plaintext passwords are still in the chat, still undisclosed, 39 days on. No status has ever been written on any of the three IG accounts. Derrek has been silent 66 days, and the $5,000 under-credit is 30 days unacknowledged. Wins: Melissa's repost network put her reel live on 23 accounts on 10-06 ('Amazing'), and she said 'Ok ill do' to the intake form.

health.rationale: Flat against the last published score (48 on 09-25). It is +3 from the mid-window low of 45 recorded by the lost 10-02 run. Engagement recovered: 37 client messages (2 in the first week, 35 in the second) against 17 on 09-25 and 2 on 10-02. Client asks rose to 3 (wire status 10-02, custom price 10-08, missing customs 10-08), from 0 in the 10-02 half, 1 on 09-25 and 0 on 09-18. Rising asks are a health signal for ALTR's churn pattern, not a tell. Two of the three asks were answered in writing the same day. Other gains: Aroosha took clear ownership of customs, Melissa's 23-account repost landed, and Stephski confirmed $6,000 with a stated remainder. All of that is offset. The re-engagement exposed that ALTR lost the 09-24 customs delivery. 'reels/ picks?' is 15 days unanswered. The missing wire bounced and the client found it, after Stephski offered to credit money never received. An unannounced vendor took a live 2FA code in the group chat for @Lizakovaal, with no status ever written on that account or the other two. Churn signals present: 3 of 4. (1) Owner silent 66 days. (3) Long-promised deliverables with no written proof: Phone Farm updates (08-01, 69 days), paid-ads stats (2025-11-18), IG recovery status (39 days). (4) Billing is the majority of ALTR-staff messages: 12 of 21, 57%. Signal (2), a results question met with a call offer, is absent: her revenue question was answered in writing. She also paid $6,000 within one day of the invoice, a fast-payment tell. Score held, not raised, because the warmth and engagement still sit on top of every structural risk from last window, all unremediated.
